subject: Two Y axis with different scale

messages.author: b88b16befbdb0a56
messages.subject: Two Y axis with different scale
parts:
I am trying to make a plot using ggplpt which has two Yaxis one in linear and one in log scale.

Can anyone help me how can I do two different scale Yaxis ?

messages.author: d809ff24ae5e05fc
messages.subject: Re: Two Y axis with different scale
parts:
HI Priya,

Typically using two scales for the y axis is frowned upon. There's lots of discussion online as to why; you could start reading about it with Hadley's comment on Stack Overflow here. Because of that, it isn't possible to do with ggplot2. If you really need to plot both data in the same chart, instead of splitting them (e.g. with facets), you'll have to use the base plot() function + par() and mess with the margins to get them to line up correctly. Something like:

plot(x,y)
par(new=TRUE, mar=c(1,1,1,1)
plot(y)

messages.subject: Re: Two Y axis with different scale

Hi,

Secondary axes are actually implemented in ggplot2:
https://ggplot2.tidyverse.org/reference/sec_axis.html

The secondary axis however must be a monotonous transformation of the
primary one, though.

Thus, i have now idea how to code the 'trans'-argument to perform the
log scaling. See also this:
https://groups.google.com/forum/#!topic/ggplot2/exNrIfD8wG8

Hope this helps, Tim
